categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in steel structure manufacturing, installation, and steel product trading, accounting for about 68% of consolidated revenue. Its steel structure business includes factory steel structures, high-rise building steel structures, and other steel structures. Additionally, it engages in construction through a subsidiary, handling general construction, leasing, and real estate development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced welding technologies including automated welding for internal box diaphragms, waveform-controlled submerged arc welding with Long Stick-Out functionality, and collaborative robotic arms for welding processes. It emphasizes automation, AI integration for welding optimization, and energy-efficient manufacturing processes. The production involves cutting, straightening, sandblasting, rust removal, painting, and assembly of steel components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include high-tech factories, office buildings, cold chain logistics facilities, and commercial and luxury residential buildings. Steel product customers span steel mills, cutting industries, fastener manufacturers, steel pipe producers, cold and hot rolling mills, automotive parts, and electrical appliance industries. The company serves mainly domestic markets with some steel product exports to China and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan with manufacturing plants in Kaohsiung and Tainan. Steel product exports reach China and Southeast Asia. The construction subsidiary operates mainly within Taiwan. The company also plans to expand export orders and cooperation with Japanese partners.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the steel industry supply chain, focusing on processing raw steel materials into steel structures and steel products. It sources raw materials like steel plates and hot-rolled steel from upstream steel mills within its group and supplies downstream construction and manufacturing sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing production capacity and automation, developing high value-added steel products, and expanding new markets and brand customers. R&D focuses on automated welding technologies, AI expert systems for welding optimization, waveform-controlled welding process improvements, and robotic welding for labor shortage mitigation. The company also emphasizes sustainability and energy efficiency in its innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of steel structures and steel products, construction project contracts, and leasing of office buildings. The company also earns income from technical services related to steel structure engineering and trading of metal products and chemicals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the four major steel structure manufacturers in Taiwan, holding a leading domestic market position. It competes on product quality, timely delivery, safety, and comprehensive management and technical certifications. The construction subsidiary is competitive due to strong financial structure, sufficient personnel, and superior engineering management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$19.7 billion, a 5% increase from the previous year, with operating profit rising 16%. Total assets were about NT$14.8 billion with equity of NT$5.4 billion. The company shows stable profitability and steady growth, supported by strong order intake in high-tech and office building sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality steel structures with superior seismic resistance and environmental sustainability, aligning with ESG principles. Its products offer faster construction times, standardized quality control, and recyclability as green building materials. Integration with group steel mills ensures high-quality raw materials, and advanced welding and automation technologies enhance productivity and reduce labor dependency.
